task: Open /home/user/Documents/photo_rgba.kra in Krita. The document is currently RGBA 8-bit with an sRGB profile. Convert the image to the Grayscale/Alpha (8-bit) color space, using any standard Grayscale profile.  Keep the 'Photo' layer. Save the file in place — the saved .kra must have colorspace GRAYA.
